sn16.3:1.3: apakasseva kāyaṃ, apakassa cittaṃ, niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā.
sn16.3:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso jarūdapānaṃ vā olokeyya pabbatavisamaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā
sn16.3:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, candūpamā kulāni upasaṅkamatha
sn16.3:1.7: apakasseva kāyaṃ, apakassa cittaṃ, niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā.
sn16.3:2.2: apakasseva kāyaṃ apakassa cittaṃ, niccanavako kulesu appagabbho.
sn16.3:2.5: “bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā, bhagavannettikā, bhagavampaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
sn16.3:3.1: atha kho bhagavā ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesi.
sn16.3:3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ayaṃ ākāse pāṇi na sajjati, na gayhati, na bajjhati,
sn16.3:3.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati, na gayhati na bajjhati
sn16.3:3.5: yathā sakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano, evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
sn16.3:3.6: evarūpo kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahati kulāni upasaṅkamituṃ.
sn16.3:4.1: kassapassa bhikkhave, kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati, na gayhati, na bajjhati
sn16.3:4.3: yathā sakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano,
sn16.3:4.4: evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano. evarūpo kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahati kulāni upasaṅkamituṃ.
sn16.3:5.2: kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti, kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhammadesanā hotīti?
sn16.3:5.3: “bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā, bhagavannettikā bhagavampaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
sn16.3:5.4: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha. bhāsissāmīti.
sn16.3:5.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn16.3:6.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave, bhikkhu evañcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn16.3:6.2: “aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ, pasannā ca me pasannākāraṃ kareyyu”nti.
sn16.3:6.3: evarūpassa kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti.
sn16.3:7.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu evañcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn16.3:7.2: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn16.3:7.3: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyu”nti.
sn16.3:7.4: iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. kāruññaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. anuddayaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. anukampaṃ upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
sn16.3:7.5: evarūpassa kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti.
sn16.3:8.1: kassapo bhikkhave, evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn16.3:8.2: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn16.3:8.3: ahovata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyu”nti.
sn16.3:8.4: iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. kāruññaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. anuddayaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. anukampaṃ upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
sn16.3:8.5: kassapena vā hi vo bhikkhave, ovadissāmi, yo vā panassa kassapasadiso. ovaditehi ca pana vo tathattāya paṭipajjitabbanti.
